test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: As of January 2022, which of the following Indian festivals is the latest to be inscribed in the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Durga Puja.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Durga Puja** is an annual **festival** celebrated in September or October, most notably in **Kolkata**, in **West Bengal of India**, and also in other parts of India amongst the **Bengalis**.
 
• This festival is the latest to be inscribed in the **UNESCO Representative list** of the **intangible cultural heritage of humanity**, in **December 2021**.
 
• The **event** was held to celebrate the marking of the UNESCO tag awarded at the **National Museum, New Delhi** in the presence of top officials of UNESCO.
 
• **Durga Puja** received the honour during UNESCO's **16th session** held in **Paris, France**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNESCO** - The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.
 
• India was recently elected as one of the members of the UNESCO Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of Intangible Cultural Heritage.
 
• **Tim Curtis** - Secretary of UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage.
 
• **Eric Falt -** Director and UNESCO Representative for the UNESCO New Delhi Office.
 
• UNESCO headquarters in Paris, France.
